site.name: AI Utility Belt
site.tagline: Private tools for AI costs, tokens and prompts
site.description: Free, private tools for AI work: forecast costs, compare model prices, count tokens, trim prompts and clean documents. Everything runs in your browser.

tools.name: Cost Forecaster
tools.desc: Forecast monthly LLM costs for chatbots, agents and batch jobs.

tools.name: Model Prices
tools.desc: Compare LLM API prices per million tokens and context windows across providers, updated daily.
tools.title: LLM API Pricing Comparison: Prices & Context Windows

tools.name: Token Counter
tools.desc: Count tokens and check whether your text fits a model's context window.

tools.name: PDF & Web to Text
tools.desc: Turn PDFs and web pages into clean, LLM-ready text.

tools.name: AI Text Cleaner
tools.desc: Strip Markdown, invisible characters and em dashes.

tools.name: Text Chunker
tools.desc: Split long documents into overlapping, token-sized chunks and test which chunk answers a question.

tools.name: Chat Export
tools.desc: Convert ChatGPT and Claude chats to Markdown, Word or PDF.

tools.name: Prompt Builder
tools.desc: Reusable prompt templates with variables, saving and share links.

tools.name: Prompt Token Optimizer
tools.desc: Cut filler and repeats from long prompts, review every change, and see what it saves.

tools.name: JSON Validator
tools.desc: Validate model output against a simple schema.
